source_locator: Mecklenburg County rows, contest CITY OF CHARLOTTE MAYOR; Total Votes summed over all precincts and vote types
verification_note: North Carolina State Board of Elections official results file for the 2011-11-08 election. Citywide Charlotte mayor totals summed over all Mecklenburg precincts: Anthony Foxx 56252; Scott Stone 26985. Write-in votes were far fewer than the runner-up. Charlotte uses partisan primaries followed by a plurality general election, so the general election decided the office. The city clerk's mayor and council history lists the winner as elected on this date.
